title: Dimensional Increase Associated with Confirmed Tool Wear
description: Shaft outer diameter measured 50.07 mm to 50.09 mm, exceeding the 50.05 mm USL. Telemetry indicated tool cycle count reached 1,180 cycles (exceeding standard 600-cycle threshold). Machine vibration rose to 3.7 mm/s. Physical inspection confirmed flank wear on the primary turning carbide insert.
confirmed_root_cause: Excessive cutting tool flank wear due to tool usage exceeding the recommended change interval (>1,000 cycles).
action_taken: Immediate replacement of carbide insert; tool offset recalibration; revised preventative tool replacement threshold to 850 cycles.
verification_method: Tool microscope visual inspection and tool wear gauge comparison.

title: Surface Chatter and High Vibration During High-Feed Machining
description: Visual inspection revealed circumferential chatter marks and micro-scratches on machined shaft surfaces. Vibration sensor telemetry logged 3.9 mm/s peak amplitude. Spindle bearing looseness detected during root cause verification.
confirmed_root_cause: Spindle bearing play combined with tool holder clamping deflection causing severe chatter.
action_taken: Spindle bearing assembly rebuild; hydraulic chuck pressure re-torqued; toolholder runout certified.
verification_method: Dial indicator dial runout check and accelerometer spectrum test.

title: Dimensional Deviation Following Tool Offset Adjustment
description: Sudden step increase in diameter on consecutive parts immediately following night-shift operator changeover. Measurement exceeded USL by 0.04 mm on first 12 parts.
confirmed_root_cause: Operator manual input error during tool wear offset register entry (offset entered as +0.03 instead of -0.03 mm).
action_taken: Corrected CNC tool offset register; quarantined initial 12 parts; implemented barcode-scanned automated tool presetter upload.
verification_method: Audit of CNC controller parameter revision history log.

title: Thermal Expansion and Dimensional Drift under Coolant Starvation
description: Gradual upward creep of shaft diameter during continuous production window. Coolant temperature increased from 24°C to 38°C over 90 minutes due to clogged coolant recirculation filter.
confirmed_root_cause: Workpiece and machine bed thermal expansion caused by degraded coolant circulation.
action_taken: Cleaned coolant sump, replaced filter elements, installed temperature interlock alarm on coolant reservoir.
verification_method: Continuous temperature logging and post-cooling dimension re-verification.

title: SOP-04: Precision CNC Turning Tool Life Management & Quality Gates
description: Standard operating procedure requiring cutting tool inspection every 300 cycles. Mandatory replacement when tool usage hits 800 cycles or flank wear band exceeds 0.2 mm. Dimensional sampling required at 100% on startup and 5-piece subgroup per hour.

title: Statistical Process Control Rules and Process Capability Targets
description: Mandates calculation of Cp and Cpk with minimum sample size of 30 parts. Target Cpk >= 1.33 for capable process, Cpk >= 1.67 for critical safety characteristics. Western Electric Nelson Rules 1-4 must trigger immediate investigation.
